about: The whole video as one directed play (docs/09 script, infographic style). Add-on lines are word for word from runs of the fixed Household Orders build (src/data/consent-fixed.json).

lines.text: Over twenty thousand people signed up for this hackathon.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words. A little awe.

lines.text: Somebody has to check all of that. That's you.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words. Playful, a wink on 'That's you'.

lines.text: So I built something for you.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words. Warm, a small smile.

lines.text: This is Hearsay. It tests what happens when a real person talks to your add-on.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words. A confident reveal on 'This is Hearsay'.

lines.text: When someone talks to your add-on, their words take a trip.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Speech recognition turns the sound into text. And sometimes, fifteen becomes fifty.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words. A knowing smile on 'fifteen becomes fifty'.

lines.text: The assistant's model picks one of your tools, and fills in the numbers.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Your add-on answers. Out loud. Every word of it.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words. Short punchy beats.

lines.text: Hearsay rides along the whole trip, and asks four questions a listener would ask.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words. A lift in energy on 'Hearsay'.

lines.text: Did it hear me right? Do I have to wait? Can I listen to this? Did I agree?
lines.direction: Brisk narrator reading four short questions, a short beat between each, curious and light.

lines.text: Here's a grocery add-on, with Hearsay playing its customer.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Fifteen is heard as fifty, and the add-on just says: added.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words.

lines.text: The customer says no to the order. It changes the order anyway.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words. Dry, a touch of disbelief.

lines.text: Every finding names the rule it breaks: Amazon's requirements for add-ons, or the MCP spec. And the pull request fails.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words.

lines.text: And you don't even have to run it yourself.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Hearsay is also an MCP server. Your coding agent runs it, fixes what it finds, and checks again, until it's green.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words.

lines.text: It can't cheat. Your suite is locked, and Hearsay keeps test cases your agent never sees.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words. Firm and confident on 'It can't cheat'.

lines.text: We measured it.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words. Serious, short.

lines.text: A suite alone made agents stop at green. So Hearsay now shows what your suite doesn't cover.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Result: as good as a precise prompt on unseen cases, better on the rules nobody told the agent about, and zero defects left behind.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words. Proud but measured.

lines.text: Consent is for your customers, not for you. Grant once, and confirm only when money moves.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words.

lines.text: You can reorder groceries up to forty dollars today.
lines.direction: A regular person talking to a smart speaker at home. Natural and relaxed, brisk everyday pace.

lines.text: Yes.
lines.direction: A regular person talking to a smart speaker at home. Natural and relaxed, brisk everyday pace.

lines.text: Add fifteen dollars of fruit.
lines.direction: A regular person talking to a smart speaker at home. Natural and relaxed, brisk everyday pace.

lines.text: That would go over the total budget you gave me. You can add less, or give me a bigger budget.
lines.direction: A friendly, clear voice assistant reading an add-on's reply. Natural, brisk, not robotic.

lines.text: Misheard fifty? Over the limit. Refused, out loud, in one sentence.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words. Punchy, satisfied.

lines.text: Add two cartons of milk.
lines.direction: A regular person talking to a smart speaker at home. Natural and relaxed, brisk everyday pace.

lines.text: Added two cartons of milk. Your cart is seven dollars and forty cents.
lines.direction: A friendly, clear voice assistant reading an add-on's reply. Natural, brisk, not robotic.

lines.text: Place the order.
lines.direction: A regular person talking to a smart speaker at home. Natural and relaxed, brisk everyday pace.

lines.text: Place the order: two cartons of milk, seven dollars and forty cents?
lines.direction: A friendly, clear voice assistant reading an add-on's reply. Natural, brisk, not robotic.

lines.text: No, not yet.
lines.direction: A regular person talking to a smart speaker at home. Natural and relaxed, brisk everyday pace.

lines.text: Okay, I did not place the order. Your cart is still there.
lines.direction: A friendly, clear voice assistant reading an add-on's reply. Natural, brisk, not robotic.

lines.text: An order never goes through on a tool's say-so. It needs a yes to a question that names what and how much. Say no, and nothing moves.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words.

lines.text: It runs in CI, without API keys, and fails the pull request before your customers ever hear it.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Hearsay is open source. Point it at your server.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk, energetic, clear; no drawn-out words. Warm, inviting finish.
